body:
417Hz is known as the frequency of change and energetic clearing. This Frequency Ring was created to help release stagnant energy, clear emotional residue, and support fresh starts.

Solid Copper at the center amplifies and conducts the frequency, while Clear Quartz anchors and magnifies the energetic field. Mother of Pearl provides emotional softness and protection during clearing work, helping transitions feel supported rather than disruptive.

Bumble Bee Jasper energizes forward movement and motivation, while Crazy Lace Agate brings lightness and emotional flow. Pyrite restores confidence and personal power after energetic release, and Yellow Tiger’s Eye strengthens boundaries and clarity.

Wrapped in gold wire, the ring creates a continuous circuit that allows clearing energy to move gently but effectively through your field throughout the day.

Charge this ring on your 417Hz Frequency Generator to keep its clearing energy active and strong.
